comparison.objective: Restock a shelf lane so the older red can remains in front of the added blue can; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Reorder and place cans in a constrained shelf lane versus precision tool alignment, hammering, withdrawal, and loose-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Correct front-to-back stock order versus four physical tang fractures and complete containment without damage.
comparison.reason: Stock rotation tests ordering and placement rather than impact finishing. The record gives demo scores but no geometric tolerances, damage rules, or full scoring rubric.
